chunk_map.heading: We built a tool that worked. It was used just a bit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "It got working and it was used just a bit." closest to violating; "It" resolves to "a local installer" in the previous sentence of the same chunk; "it" in "(Lucky it did not take that long to build it.)" likewise. L8 "your team builds" is self-contained.
No pointer to another file or slide by position; L4 "One of the first things we tried building" is narrator history, not a callback to a deck slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw/caught" reference in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal demo beat; narrated essay paragraph

rules_evaluated.evidence: L1-L8: slide carries a self-contained claim in L8 "more of what your team builds will work; whether a customer needs it is still decided before the build" plus the narrated story in L4.
L1 "We built a tool that worked. It was used just a bit." is borne out by L4 "It got working and it was used just a bit"; nothing contradicts it.

Closest: L8 "more of what your team builds will work; whether a customer needs it is still decided before the build" is one declarative with a semicolon, not a "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction; no triple, no superlative, no number, no abstraction-noun stack, no verb triplet in the chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body vocabulary (installer, ecosystem, customer, build) is ordinary engineering/product register; no surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, beat, mood. grep banned_words CLEAN (0 hits).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of body for ** returns 0 bold elements; only L6 byline italic title, which is a title not emphasis.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slide file is included by line in curriculum/lectures/apt101-building-is-cheap.md (grep of the slide id), so it reaches the composed deck as a ## chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/the-installer-nobody-needed.md -> "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent." exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/the-installer-nobody-needed.md -> "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body; rule is a review surface, never a gate

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/the-installer-nobody-needed.md -> "oversized: 0 ... every slide is within limits" exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "We built a tool that worked. It was used just a bit." is a declarative claim, the lecture-heading grammar; the slide is a narrator beat in a lecture manifest, not an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 bridge sentence; it adds the move the story owes (the lesson for the audience) and does not restate the L1 header, so not a (c) kicker; no doctrine restatement or design commentary in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer note L12 records header and body built together on 2026-10-07 ("header and body from apt101-squint.md Day 1"); no inherited bullets from an older header; L4 and L8 both answer L1.
